status: candidate schedule model; all timings are inherited synthetic values or explicitly marked hypotheses

service.name: top-k selected-block KKA service
service.contract: Given a query and a PRISM/Thresholder-selected set of KV blocks, compute KKA output for those blocks and emit a result at the declared output boundary.
service.quality_equivalence: not yet specified; required before comparison against digital baseline

assumptions: DAC and Modulator are sequential: input encoding must precede optical PRISM computation.
Thresholder selection depends on PRISM results.
Both KKA lanes consume the same selected-block set and can run independently; this is an architectural hypothesis, not established by a KKA implementation.
KKA lane duration 60 ps is a hypothetical 2-way parallel candidate derived from the synthetic 120 ps KKA fixture; it is not a measured speedup.
The join/routing/synchronization operation costs 15 ps, an explicit unvalidated allowance.
Photodetection and ADC occur after joined KKA output.
No queueing, clock-domain crossing, calibration delay, retry, or thermal throttling is included unless represented as a task.
